blocks.text: Any appeal to the imposition of a fee or charge as provided for in this article shall be governed by the administrative appeal provisions contained in TMC 2.45.010 et seq., as may be amended. (Ord. 19300 § 39, 8-25-09. Code 1995 § 146-152.)
